Title: French National Championship - July 4th and 5th in Soissons

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Fellow Methuselahs,

You are invited to the French NC that will take place this year in  Soissons , a hundred kilometers north-east from Paris (1h by car, less if you ride a giant bat).

French NC are divided in Day 1 (Last Chance Qualifier) on Saturday, and the Championship itself on Sunday. It's not an Open, so you'll need to qualify first.

More details to come.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
